lines.text: Ryan wore his heaviest coat on a frosty November morning.
On the first climb he was sweating, so he took it off.
Minutes later he froze in a damp T-shirt.
Here's the fix. Dress in thin layers.
A base layer that wicks sweat, a fleece for warmth, and a wind or rain shell on top.
Too warm? Take one off. Cold at the break? Add it back.
Save this before your next cold hike.
